newsitem.title: GREECE: GREEK 12MTH T-BILL RATE TO BE CUT TO 11.10PCT.
newsitem.headline: GREEK 12MTH T-BILL RATE TO BE CUT TO 11.10PCT.

text.p: Greek Deputy Finance Minister Nickos Christodoulakis told reporters that the new 12-month T-bill issue will feature a lower interest rate of 11.10 percent, down from 11.20 percent in early January.
Christodoulakis said in late December that Greece would issue 12-month T-bills on January 31.

The finance ministry plans an auction of three-year coupon bonds and seven-year floaters on January 24. The first annual coupon of FRNs is based on the 12-month T-bill rate plus a spread. --Dimitris Kontogiannis, Athens Newsroom +301 3311812-4
